title: Reporter-ion quantitation auxiliary array contract
description: Schema for the per-MS2 reporter-intensity auxiliary array carrier (Phase 35, QUANT-01..02). The aux-array contract stores reporter-ion intensities as a NonStandardDataArray named 'reporter_intensity' in the spectrum's auxiliary_arrays Parquet column. The channel_id param (semicolon-separated for multi-channel) on the DataArray identifies which Phase-34 labeled sample_list channels produced each intensity value.

array_name.description: The NonStandardDataArray name. The mzPeak writer routes this to the auxiliary_arrays Parquet column (not a registered POINT column). Recovered via BinaryArrayMap.get(ArrayType::NonStandardDataArray { name: 'reporter_intensity' }).

channel_id_param_key.description: The Param name on the DataArray that carries the Phase-34 channel id(s). The value is the bare sample_list.id of each labeled channel (the slugified SDRF source name, e.g. 'sample-1') — NOT a compound 'sample::label' form. For single-channel it is one id; for multi-channel it is a semicolon-separated list in the same order as the intensity values (e.g. 'sample-1;sample-2').

data_type.description: Each intensity value is stored as a Float64 (8 bytes, little-endian IEEE 754). The values are in channel order (matching the order of channel_ids in the channel_id param).

carrier.description: The chosen carrier contract (from the Phase 35-01 decision gate): aux-array. The channel_id Param survives write→finish→read-back via MzPeakReader::get_spectrum_arrays (confirmed by spike test channel_id_survives_own_reader_readback).

channel_id_format.description: Encoding rule for multi-channel: ids are joined with ';' in the order of the intensity vector. Recoverable by: channel_ids = channel_id_param.value.split(';'), then zip(channel_ids, decoded_f64_array).

missing_intensity_sentinel.description: A channel whose reporter_mz has no peak within tolerance yields 0.0 (recorded absence). A channel whose reporter_mz is null (TMTpro high channel, CHAN-03) is OMITTED entirely (no entry, no sentinel).

scope.description: Reporter intensities are emitted only for MS2 spectra (ms_level == 2). MS1 spectra are unchanged.

flag.description: CLI flag that activates reporter-quant emit. OFF by default. Only meaningful with --sdrf on an isobaric (Phase-34) run. Absent flag => byte-identical output (no reporter_intensity array, no channel_id param).
